name: The Endgame Is Me
summary: A reverse boss fight in pixel art. You are the raid boss, and your job is to pace between a rock and another rock. Five-mans, 25- and 40-man raids, and one quiet man on a horse keep interrupting. Stomp them, breathe fire, shake the horse guy out of your fur, and spend your points on new abilities between maps. The campaign runs seven levels, from a forest clearing to razing the castle.
